params.body:
The default descriptions of Signal, Decode and Intelligence, matching the new pricing copy on gentells.com (Trendwolves/gentells-site#277, from the copy update brief in Portal mail:47). The site holds the same defaults in `App\Plans\Offer`.

- Signal: For the independent strategist: the full archive, and the opportunity behind every post.
- Decode: For teams who brief others: everything in Signal, plus every report we publish, ready for your next deck.
- Intelligence: Everything in Decode, plus a quarterly read on your category, written for the decisions you face, and a direct line to Maarten Leyts.

These are defaults only. An offer already saved under Settings > Plans keeps its own descriptions until it is saved again with these, and that saved offer is what gentells.com shows.

Tests: the full suite, 1612 of 1612.

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)
